Module com.tasktopia
Package com.tasktopia.model

Class SqliteTaskDAO

java.lang.Object
com.tasktopia.model.SqliteTaskDAO
All Implemented Interfaces:
ITaskDAO
public class SqliteTaskDAO extends Object implements ITaskDAO
SQLite-backed implementation of ITaskDAO.

Performs CRUD operations on the tasks table using the shared connection provided by SqliteConnection. Generated primary keys are written back to the Task object after a successful insert.

Date values are stored as ISO-8601 strings and parsed back via parseDateTime(String), which handles both legacy date-only strings (yyyy-MM-dd) and full date-time strings (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss).

All SQL exceptions are caught and printed to standard error rather than propagated, so callers should verify return values where correctness matters.

  • Method Details

    • addTask

      public void addTask(Task task)
      Inserts a new task into the tasks table. The generated database ID is assigned back to the task object. If Task.getPriority() is null, "MEDIUM" is stored.
      Specified by:
      addTask in interface ITaskDAO
      Parameters:
      task - the Task to insert; must not be null

    • updateTask

      public void updateTask(Task task)
      Updates an existing task record in the tasks table. The task is identified by its id. If Task.getPriority() is null, "MEDIUM" is stored.
      Specified by:
      updateTask in interface ITaskDAO
      Parameters:
      task - the Task containing updated field values; must not be null
